finding: Every day about 32,000 ride-hail trips run between two places beside the same ‘L’ line, at about $11 a ride against $2.50 by train. Between 1 and 3 a.m., when the trains thin out, a third of all ride-hail trips do. Along the Blue Line, 58% of such trips copy a train ride that a rider who cannot take the stairs could not make.

ledger.source: City of Chicago, Transportation Network Providers - Trips (2025-)
method: trips with both census tracts, by pickup tract, drop-off tract and hour
a copy: both tracts have residents within half a mile of stations on one line (expected share)
caveats: 42% of trips have a tract withheld and are left out
fares rounded to $2.50 by the City; tips and charges not included
